_about: Hooks in this project are safeguards: they block or flag actions that break Spendly's rules (CLAUDE.md), and can be used to fire a custom slash command on the event we want (a hook can't type the command itself, so its output tells Claude to run it, like the SessionStart hook below that fires /explorer). Scripts live in .claude/hooks/.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Spendly session start: before answering the developer'"'"'s first message, run the /explorer slash command (.claude/commands/explorer.md): launch the explorer subagent and relay its briefing as-is. Then handle the developer'"'"'s first message instead of asking what they want to work on. Skip this if the first message is itself /explorer."}}'
